name: Apprenticeship — E&M DivideByZeroException (FLP-2103)
description: Minimal repro for FLP-2103: an English & Maths course made of two ILR rows where the second (final) row has StartDate == EndDate on a non-month-end day. The merged period's OriginalExpectedEndDate rolls back a calendar month via LastCensusDate(), making CalculateNumberOfInstalments return 0 and EnglishAndMathsPayments divide by zero.
